finding: Two native payment-pool timeouts while payment request and callback leases were in commit. The nearest sample had two general connections available, five payment waiters, all24 pooler server connections active and18 database WALWrite waiters. Temporal correlation does not establish the cause of the commit stall.
decision_result: Reject candidate for adoption; no demonstrated improvement. Preserve failed gates despite independent integrity recovery. Do not progress to hourly qualification.
next_hypothesis: Rebalance four existing API connections from general2/payment2 to general1/payment3 on the accepted control image; keep total connections, pooler24, wait500ms, workload and all gates unchanged. Pooler saturation means this may relocate waiting rather than remove it; stop if general requests regress.
